items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: I liked Roy... we happened to kind of know each other from then on through the years.

ctx.x: Well, when we went to record a session, that was in 1939. We went down to [RCA] Victor.* The tune was finished there. They wanted to know what my sixth tune was gonna be. I said give me a half hour. So, I took my rhythm section and I went over to a corner and I made up the introduction and finished out the first chorus. And then, I got back to the band. We talked over an ensemble chorus for the last chorus because the music in the beginning wasn't even on paper. We did that from head. We finished the whole tune.…
* RCA Victor did not exist then; it was merely Victor Records.
